seo.title: Business Glossary — GST, Accounting & POS Terms
seo.description: 253 business terms explained in plain English — GST, margin, inventory, payroll, bookkeeping and POS jargon, each with a formula, example and free tool.

hero.headline: Business terms, explained plainly
hero.subheadline: 253 terms from the invoices, ledgers, menus and stock registers Indian business owners work with every day — each with a formula, an example and the free Setu tool that does the maths for you.
